maps.name: Ember Rhythm
maps.intent: Learn to pump two rollers, carry that rhythm into a visible gap, then repeat with a quicker pop.
maps.signature: Pumping rhythm becomes flight timing; a broad tabletop teaches the motion before the first void.

maps.name: Azure Terrace
maps.intent: Climb toward a visible terrace, rehearse an elevated catch, then reveal the skyline with one high spring.
maps.signature: A 10-unit spring lift unlocks an upper route; the final terraced descent releases the tension.

maps.name: Fuse Halo
maps.intent: Teach curved takeoff, show the explosive connector and loop, then give the player a safe ground return.
maps.signature: One boosted one-use loop is the landmark; the connector disappears only after full-bike clearance.

maps.name: Skyline Courier
maps.intent: Teach the high bridge route, then use an optional crest barrel for a short aerial delivery onto a readable catch.
maps.signature: A barrel-assisted skybridge pop is the centerpiece; the ground route remains continuous below it.

maps.name: Broken Horizon
maps.intent: Build a sense of increasing horizontal distance, then let a spring carry the bike across the central canyon.
maps.signature: A 36-unit void and long eight-coin spring arc create the widest single reveal so far.

maps.name: Basalt Descent
maps.intent: Teach braking and descending alignment in successive lower catch basins, separated by stabilization shelves.
maps.signature: A downhill route built around horizontal drops and sloped catches; braking, rather than boosts, sets the pace.

maps.name: Quarry Cadence
maps.intent: Alternate deliberate low-speed ledges with a faster optional loop so speed control becomes the central skill.
maps.signature: Curb, double curb, elevated catch, then a wide explosive halo; each speed regime has its own reset.

maps.name: Cloud Observatory
maps.intent: Make the upper destination the visual goal, reach it through a tall spring reveal, then explore its raised bridge.
maps.signature: A 14-unit lift leads to a raised roller bridge with an optional barrel reprise.

maps.name: Redline Viaduct
maps.intent: Build speed through compression, spend it on a tall optional loop, recover, then test one long manual gap.
maps.signature: A tall explosive halo and long-clear gap form two separated peaks, with a downhill bridge between them.

maps.name: Crown Relay
maps.intent: Recombine Cinder Crown's features into a relay: manual gap, one-use inversion, upper terrace, barrel flourish and final wide crossing.
maps.signature: Two spring transfers with different purposes are separated by an upper bridge and recovery; the final crossing gets the largest coin budget.
